title: Tracking large chemical reaction networks and rare events by neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2512.10309v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chemical reaction networks are widely used to model stochastic dynamics in biophysical processes. Their exact probabilistic description via the chemical master equation becomes intractable for high-dimensional systems due to the exponential growth of the state space. This difficulty is further exacerbated when metastable transitions and rare events dominate the dynamics. Here, we present an advanced neural-network approach that effectively tackles large reaction networks and rare-event dynamics within a unified framework. Building on autoregressive representations of the full joint probability distribution, we achieve efficient training through second-order optimization methods, including natural gradient descent and the time-dependent variational principle. translated_title: 利用神经网络追踪大型化学反应网络与稀有事件
translated_abstract: 化学反应网络被广泛用于模拟生物物理过程中的随机动力学。通过化学主方程对其进行精确的概率描述，在高维系统中会因状态空间的指数级增长而变得难以处理。当亚稳态跃迁和稀有事件主导动力学行为时，这一困难会进一步加剧。在此，我们提出了一种先进的神经网络方法，能够在统一框架内有效处理大型反应网络和稀有事件动力学。基于完整联合概率分布的自回归表示，我们通过二阶优化方法（包括自然梯度下降和含时变分原理）实现了高效训练。我们利用增强采样策略，能够准确解析控制稀有跃迁的低概率区域。我们在多稳态
tldr: 提出了一种基于自回归概率分布表示、二阶优化与增强采样策略的统一神经网络框架，可高效求解大型化学反应网络的化学主方程，并精确捕捉稀有事件与亚稳态跃迁动力学。
en_tdlr: We propose a unified neural-network framework based on autoregressive representations, second-order optimization, and enhanced sampling strategies that efficiently solves the chemical master equation for large reaction networks and accurately captures rare-event and metastable transition dynamics.
